label: B1 · STRESS
text: The sensor vendor now confirms that after a reconnect, a stale-but-plausible glucose value can persist for up to 45 seconds. The current self-test checks electrical connectivity but does not check freshness. A separate timestamp source exists, but the release does not yet use it.
principle: STRESS changes a safety assumption, not merely a test result. Re-examine whether your stated boundary still protects against the hazard.
